draft.text: You came in because you've been feeling stressed and having trouble with your mood, sleep, and eating habits over the past year and a half.
You mentioned gaining some weight and having trouble sleeping, waking up early, and not eating well.
You are experiencing symptoms of depression, including changes in mood, trouble sleeping, and a decreased appetite.
You also have high blood pressure that has been mostly under control, but recent readings have been concerning.
Your doctor will continue to monitor your blood pressure and depression symptoms.
You will be encouraged to keep track of your blood pressure at home and report any changes.
The next steps will be discussed based on your progress.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been feeling stressed and having trouble with your mood, sleep, and appetite for about 1.5 years.
We found that your blood pressure has been under relatively good control with lisinopril, but you have noticed some recent changes.
You are experiencing symptoms of depression, including changes in mood, trouble sleeping, and a decreased appetite.
We will continue to monitor your blood pressure and depression symptoms.
You will be encouraged to keep track of your blood pressure readings at home and report any changes.
We will also discuss ways to help with your diet and exercise routine.
